title: DoS module run configuration (paper Listing 1)
description: JSON Schema used by dos_module.config to validate run.yaml before any run cell is executed. Field-level 'description' entries double as the documentation JSON cannot carry as comments; see configs/run.example.yaml for the human-annotated version.

run.description: Top-level run metadata and output location.

run_id.description: Optional explicit run id; auto-generated (uuid4) if omitted.

output_dir.description: Directory where JSON/JSONL RunRecords (Table 6) are written.

repetitions.description: n >= 5 repetitions per (vector x load x mitigation) cell, per implementation-plan.txt Phase 5.

randomize_order.description: Randomize run order across cells to avoid ordering confounds (Phase 5).

discard_warmup_runs.description: Number of leading warm-up repetitions to discard per cell before recording (Phase 5).

target.description: The MCP server under test. Localhost-only by design: host must be a loopback address; enforced both here and again in dos_module/config.py so a hand-edited config cannot bypass it.

sdk.description: Which official MCP SDK the target server is built on (modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk 'mcp' or modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk').

transport.description: Transport in scope for this run.

host.description: MUST be loopback. This harness never targets non-loopback addresses by default.

port.description: TCP port for streamable_http/sse targets; null for stdio.

server_command.description: argv used to launch the target server subprocess for stdio transport, e.g. ["python", "-m", "target_server"]. Null when attaching to an already-running HTTP/SSE server.

pid_discovery.description: How the resource sampler finds the target process to attach psutil to.

interval_ms.description: Fixed resource-sampling interval in milliseconds; must be held constant across all runs (Phase 3 FILL item). Paper default: 100ms.

backend.description: psutil is used on this Windows measurement harness (no native cgroups). On a Linux deployment, swap to 'cgroup' (memory.peak/cpu.stat) for higher fidelity -- see measure/sampler.py docstring for exactly what is lost by using psutil. Never silently mix backends within one experiment; record the backend actually used in Table 5.

rate_hz.description: Steady request cadence of the well-formed benign traffic whose degradation is measured (the harness's synthetic 'legitimate user').

request_timeout_s.description: A benign request slower than this counts as an error for error_rate purposes.

baseline_duration_s.description: Duration of the no-attack baseline window used to compute baseline_p95_ms, which the recovery-time definition below is relative to.

vectors.description: Which of the 7 in-scope DoS vectors to run this pass, and each one's load/concurrency sweep.

id.description: Must match a vector_id registered in dos_module/vectors/.

enabled.description: Set false to keep the vector's config block in the file (for reference) without running it.

load_levels.description: Vector-specific load-magnitude sweep points (paper Table 3), e.g. payload-size multiplier, requests/sec, JSON nesting depth, concurrent slow connections. Unit is vector-specific -- document it per vector in the paper, not just here.

concurrency.description: Concurrency levels swept per Phase 5's default [1, 8, 32, 128].

mitigation.description: false = attack sweep without the corresponding control; true = repeat the identical sweep with the vector's mitigation enabled on the target (Phase 4/5).

extra.description: Vector-specific knobs not covered by the common fields above (e.g. nesting depth step size, regex pattern id under test). Passed through verbatim to AttackContext.extra.

recovery.description: Precise definition of 'recovered' -- must be held constant across all runs (Phase 3 FILL item).

threshold_pct_of_baseline.description: Benign p95 latency must fall to/below this percent of its pre-attack baseline_p95_ms to count as recovered. 110 is this harness's placeholder default (i.e. within 10% of baseline); the paper's Section 4.2 must state its final chosen value explicitly, not inherit this default silently.

max_wait_s.description: If latency has not recovered within this many seconds after attack stop, recovery_s is recorded as null (not 'infinite', not 0).

amplification.description: Cost units for amplification = target_cost / attacker_cost (Phase 3 FILL item). Both units must be fixed before running anything; see measure/results_writer.compute_amplification.

attacker_cost_unit.description: Unit the attacker-side cost is measured in for this experiment.

target_cost_unit.description: Unit the target-side cost is measured in for this experiment.
